rationale: The primary cell is an interpretable null, not a noise-dominated one: H1 rarefied distinct gain = -0.2 (CI [-1.1, 0.7]), exact sign-flip p = 0.84375 against a min_achievable_p of 0.00781, so the endpoint had power and the data simply show no diversity gain; the fixed-sequence gate is closed and H2 (+0.1, p = 1.0, floor 0.25) is descriptive. The null is clean: zero k-mismatches, nonempty_patch_fraction 0.94 vs 0.98 (no productivity confound; the non-empty robustness row is -0.03, p = 0.945), and the control's token total (12.40M) exceeds the treatment's (11.38M), so the control was not starved. The substantive reading is a ceiling effect — vanilla resampling at T=0.7 already yields ~4.0 structurally distinct patches of k*=5 vs the treatment's 3.8 — and the tau sweep shows the gate signal saturated all-singleton (entropy = ln 5 on all 10 instances, realized N=5 everywhere, branch_rate 1.0 at every tau < ln 5), reproducing threat 11: the entropy gate carried no information this run. Per the decision principles, a negative primary signal makes the mechanism contrast the most informative next cell: sdlg_t0.7 is the confidence-independent generator R5.4 requires, it is the only arm that can speak to the two off-mode recovery candidates (12096 and 18763: treatment 2/5 vs vanilla 0/5), and it discriminates between 'branching per se adds nothing over T=0.7 resampling on this substrate' and 'the strategy-proposal generator specifically failed to out-diversify sampling'. A repeat seed is dispreferred because p = 0.844 is not borderline — seed2 would spend a full GPU run re-confirming a flat null — and temperature/clustering cells are premature while the mechanism story is unanchored and the NLI partitions are degenerate.
expectations: If the SDLG arm's (exploratory) rarefied distinct gain vs the same matched-k vanilla control is also null or negative, the strategy-arm null generalizes across generators: the paper reports that at T=0.7 on easy SymPy, plain resampling already saturates structural patch diversity and neither mechanism-driven generator adds coverage — the off-mode candidates are then likely sampling noise, and the headline becomes a well-controlled negative result with the gate reported as uninformative (threat 11). If SDLG shows a positive diversity gain (and especially any coverage delta or replication of the off-mode pattern), the mechanism matters: the strategy-proposal null is attributable to that generator (confidence-coupled, lexically out-diversified by sampling) rather than to branching itself, which sharpens the R5.4 confidence-independence story and would motivate the temperature cells (strategy_t0.2 next, where vanilla's sampling diversity should shrink) to map where mechanism-driven diversity pays. Either outcome changes what the paper says; neither can alter the confirmatory record, which is fixed at the run-3 primary.
